audience.editorialTarget: Parents, carers and teachers of children aged 3–10
audience.usageRule: Owner direction, 2026-10-23: designed for ages 3–10; younger children can explore with a parent. The 4+ content rating and Apple Kids primary age band 6–8 are separate classifications, not the full product audience. Do not promise independent use of every activity at every age.

access.download: Free to download on the verified iOS listing.
freeDailyEntitlements: up to three new free reading chapters per local day, within ten free chapters total
three minutes of Earth Shield per day
one discovery mission per theme per day
plusEntitlements: published story library and available English/Turkish narration while active
access.usageRule: Text and narration allowances are separate. Every plan has at most one new chapter per animal per local day after completion and a later eligible Radar opening. Earned free chapters remain available to replay.

stories.liveCatalog: The public listing describes eight recurring storybook heroes with five chapters each.
stories.liveProgression: Choose 10 free story chapters in total, with up to 3 new chapters per day. These free chapters stay yours to replay. Every plan, including Plus, discovers at most one new chapter per animal per day: finish the current chapter, then meet that friend on Radar on a later day.
stories.fixedVsDaily: The current published catalog contains eight heroes and forty chapters. Daily discovery is not daily story generation or a promise of future publication cadence.

offline.liveClaim: Each hero’s first chapter and downloaded chapters can be read offline when you have access. New chapter and narration downloads, live sky data and purchases need a connection. Offline sample visitors are not today’s live sky.
offline.limit: Saved paid content still requires applicable access; no permanent ownership promise for subscription-only content.

publicClaims: purchases, external links and reminder controls are behind a parent gate
processedDataSummary: purchase entitlement and transaction metadata via Apple or Google and RevenueCat
notification token, reminder time and permission state when reminders are enabled
network IP may be processed by infrastructure providers; Rockimals stores a rate-limit digest rather than the raw IP
requested chapter/language and starter chapter selections
random app-data narration installation scope and selected free audio chapter
signed Apple purchase proofs sent to protected delivery service for independent Apple verification
dataAndParentControls.usageRule: Never say that Rockimals processes no data. Describe concrete product behavior, link the current privacy policy, and avoid legal-compliance or absolute-safety guarantees.

retentionReview.policy: Maximum 13 months after installation last activity; includes free chapter and narration allowance records. Earlier deletion can be requested.
retentionReview.identifiedIssue: Live metadata shows narration trials reference installations without ON DELETE CASCADE, while rockimals_delete_installations does not delete narration trials. Affected installations can block deletion.
retentionReview.resolution: Owner-approved migration 20261017204836_rockimals_narration_trial_deletion_cascade applied to production on 2026-10-17. Validated ON DELETE CASCADE now removes narration scopes with their installation. Bounded before/after checks used synthetic rows and ROLLBACK; no existing customer data was deleted. RLS/grants and the 03:17 UTC retention job remain unchanged.

nasaBoundary.allowed: The product uses NASA near-Earth asteroid data for visitor facts.
nasaBoundary.requiredDisclosure: Rockimals is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by NASA.
nasaBoundary.fictionBoundary: Animal visitors, names and stories are imaginative fiction; asteroid designations and selected measurements are science data.
